data.name: Hotel Real de Castilla
data.address: C. Colón 184, Zona Centro, 44100 Guadalajara, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
In an elegant, Colonial-style building dating from the 17th century, this relaxed hotel is in the city center. It's a 5-minute walk from Guadalajara Cathedral and 19 km from Miguel Hidalgo y Costilla International Airport.
Simply furnished rooms have Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs. Family rooms sleep up to 6 people. Room service is available.
Amenities include breakfast, an unfussy seafood restaurant, and an interior courtyard with seating and a water feature.
